facts.fact: Service update flow uses Compact Flash media and USB mass-storage transfer as a copy path to CF.
Service update boot is entered while powering on with the Window button held.
Service notes show update screen text with file token M25V100B.BIN and instruction to press F6 (DO IT).
Service notes state update is not performed directly from a computer over USB; CF media is required.
Service notes indicate user input is not accepted while USB cable is connected in the transfer state.
Test OS installation follows normal OS update procedure and remains active until regular OS is reinstalled.
JIG PC Flash ROM workflow references socket J110 on the CPU board for test/boot-block recovery usage.
Service parts list for PC CPU board includes IC2 AM29LV641DL90REI flash ROM.
Operator manual states Compact Flash card support range is 32MB to 2GB.
Operator manual states USB connection is mass-storage class oriented around memory card/internal HDD, not direct internal-memory visibility.
Operator manual describes USB mode entry from LOAD/SAVE pages via F4 (USB), and warns page/mode changes are blocked until USB cable disconnect.
Operator manual specs include 240x64 LCD, USB mass-storage class support, 5-pin DIN MIDI in x2 and out x4.
Operator manual indicates internal flash contains factory preset data and bundled CF INTERNAL folder mirrors default data.
